title: Where you recharge
idea: Jung described two attitudes: turning energy inward or outward. Some people recharge alone, others with people. Neither is better.
apply: Notice what recharges you after a long week, then schedule it on purpose.
remind: Know how you recharge. Plan for it.
who: Noor, who says yes to every social plan.

scenes.nar: Noor says yes to everything. Friday dinner, Saturday party, Sunday brunch.
By Monday she is drained, and cannot work out why, since she enjoyed all of it.
Jung described two attitudes. Some people recharge outward, with people. Others recharge inward, alone. Noor recognizes herself in the second, and neither is better.
She keeps one social plan, leaves early, and protects a quiet Saturday. On Monday she is rested, and her friends still see her.
